aimutils.title: Aim Utils
aimutils.sensitivity.description: Range [0, 1] corresponds to in-game [0%%, 200%%]. Do not worry about the value being rounded to the nearest 0.005, it actually gets applied! With linear sensitivity on, the value is the turn multiplier instead: 1 turns like in-game 100%%.
aimutils.range.description: Range [0, 1] corresponds to in-game [0%%, 200%%]. With linear sensitivity on, the value is the turn multiplier instead: 1 turns like in-game 100%%.
aimutils.randomize.description: Set the mouse sensitivity to a random value between min and max.
aimutils.menu.description: Cursor speed when outside the world, like the inventory. This may break or have issues!
aimutils.menu.unsupported: Unavailable: Something broke or the current Wayland setup doesn't work with it.
